moduleTitle: Theme 1: People and lifestyle — Healthy living and lifestyle

note.specFocus: Balanced diets, exercise and fitness, risks of smoking, alcohol and drugs, stress, sleep, and opinions on healthy and unhealthy lifestyles.
note.sourcePages: Original practice material written to match the AQA GCSE German (8668) themes; no supplied booklet used.
note.summary:
1.2 Healthy living and lifestyle
Key vocabulary
- gesund = healthy
- sich ausgewogen ernähren = to eat a balanced diet
- regelmäßig trainieren = to exercise regularly
- die Gesundheit = health
- süchtig werden = to become addicted
- gestresst/entspannt = stressed/relaxed

Key grammar
- Use zu + infinitive for purpose/necessity: um fit zu bleiben / ich versuche, genug zu schlafen.
- Comparatives: gesünder, wichtiger, weniger schädlich; besser with als.
- Modal verbs: man sollte..., man muss..., ich darf nicht...; the infinitive goes to the end.

Exam tips
- Use a range of vocabulary but keep German word order accurate.
- Justify opinions with denn/weil and a clear reason; check present, perfect, future and conditional time frames.
- In comprehension, distinguish nicht, kein and nie: negatives may reverse the intended answer.
